answer.reason: Beyond its building, the verses say the king put his gold shields there and that its vessels were all of pure gold.

clauses.english: was where Solomon put his three hundred shields of beaten gold
clauses.quote: the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon

clauses.english: had all its vessels made of pure gold, none of silver
clauses.quote: all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold

doubts: ISA 22:8 mentions the armour of the house of the forest, but says nothing of what happened there, so it was left out.
